svg.title: Kenya: where the ads ran, and the ad cost per person who started
svg.desc: Kenya, with 81 radius areas of 2 to 9 km around towns drawn to scale, and dashed outlines for 10 cities excluded at 16 km and Nairobi at 24 km. Below, the advertising cost per person who started the survey: Whole country $1.90; Whole country except Nairobi $0.18; Whole country except 10 cities $0.56; Inside 81 radius areas $0.06; Outside the 81 radius areas $0.02.
